answer: Salted beacon slot lottery.** Each epoch a threshold-BLS beacon publishes an unpredictable seed; identities derive their duty slot as hash(seed, key), revealed only after the seed lands. A wharf node accepts work only from agents holding the slot matching that epoch. An attacker must register agents before the seed exists, so pre-buying N identities to dominate slots succeeds with probability falling as 1/N, and buying enough to reliably win forces payment at knoll registration desks for surplus identities that mostly go unused.
